title: Shopify Growth Lead
description:
Shopify Growth Lead
 



  





 Location: Hybrid
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 5\-6 years 
 



  





**About NapChief:** 




 NapChief is a fast\-growing D2C kidswear brand. We sell through our own website (napchief.com) and all major marketplaces including Myntra, FirstCry, and Amazon. At Nap Chief, we're redefining kids' wear for a new generation of parents. We craft premium, super\-soft clothing that kids love to wear and parents trust. Our mission is to empower the young generation and we are looking for you to join forces with us to conquer this mission. 
 



  





**About the role:** 




 You will own the website business end\-to\-end: revenue, profitability (CM2\), merchandising, conversion, retention, and the promotional calendar. Everything that determines whether napchief.com grows profitably sits with you. You operate it like your own store, working through a junior team and in partnership with the performance marketing lead.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 Revenue and P\&L ownership:
 


* Own monthly and quarterly website revenue targets and CM2 (contribution margin) targets. Build the revenue plan: traffic × conversion × AOV × repeat rate, and manage every lever in it.
* Report weekly on revenue performance, drivers, and corrective actions in the business review.



  





 Merchandising and launches:
 


* Own the site merchandising calendar: new collection drops, product launches, collection pages, bestseller placement, and catalog presentation.
* Plan launches for a seasonal kidswear line — winter\-weight and summer\-weight assortments, size runs, and gifting windows — jointly with the fashion buyer so demand plans are backed by inventory.
* Own pricing and offer architecture on the website: bundles, sets, first\-purchase offers, and price\-point strategy.



  





 Promotions and sale events:
 


* Own the full sale calendar: festive\-season events, end\-of\-season sales, and campaign\-led promotions.
* Design promotion mechanics (tiered offers, bundles, category\-level discounts) that deliver revenue spikes while protecting contribution margin — moving beyond blanket sitewide discounting.
* Run each event end\-to\-end: stock planning with the buyer, site preparation, communication plan across email/WhatsApp/ads, live monitoring, and post\-event P\&L review.



  





 Retention and CRM:
 


* Own the full repeat\-purchase system: email, WhatsApp, and SMS marketing — segmentation, campaign calendar, and automated flows (welcome, post\-purchase, replenishment/size\-up, winback, abandoned checkout).
* Own cohort retention and LTV: track repeat rates by cohort, diagnose drop\-offs, and build programs that bring customers back as their kids grow into the next size.
* Own the post\-purchase experience on the website side: order communication, review collection, and the "how did you hear about us" survey program.



  





 Conversion rate and AOV:
 


* Own funnel performance: landing pages, collection pages, PDPs, cart, and checkout. Run a continuous, prioritized testing program.
* Own AOV programs: bundling, upsells, cross\-sells, and free\-shipping thresholds.
* Own the Shopify tech stack: app selection, site speed, search and navigation, and theme\-level improvements (directing developers/tools as needed).



  





 Performance marketing partnership:
 


* Allocate acquisition budgets to the performance marketing manager based on the revenue plan; review return jointly every week. You are mutually accountable — their new\-customer numbers feed your revenue targets.



  





 Analytics and team:
 


* Maintain the website dashboard: conversion, AOV, repeat rate, cohorts, CM2 by category — the numbers leadership reviews weekly.
* Manage and develop the junior team (marketing executives and performance associates), setting their weekly plans and reviewing output.



  





 KPIs you own:
 


* Website revenue vs plan
* CM2 (contribution margin) on website business
* Conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchase rate / LTV
* Sale\-event revenue and margin outcomes



  





 Requirements:
 


* 5\-6 years in D2C with recent, hands\-on revenue ownership — you have grown a store's numbers yourself, with results you can quantify and defend. "Worked at a D2C brand" in a coordination or support role does not qualify.
* Fluency across the Shopify ecosystem: storefront, apps, analytics, and CRM/marketing tools (Klaviyo or equivalent email platform; WhatsApp marketing tools).
* Strong analytical grounding: cohort analysis, funnel metrics, unit economics, and margin math are daily working tools for you.
* Experience planning and running sale events with P\&L accountability.
* Experience getting work done through a junior team — this role is an enabler, not a solo contributor.
* Background in a growing brand or startup environment, where targets moved and you moved with them.

**About Accion** 




 Accion is a global nonprofit on a mission to create a fair and inclusive economy for the 1\.6 billion people who are failed by the global financial system. We develop and scale responsible digital financial solutions for small business owners, smallholder farmers, and women, so they can make informed decisions and improve their lives. Through targeted investment strategies, advisory solutions, and expert thought leadership, we work with local partners to develop and scale cheaper, more accessible, and customer\-friendly financial solutions. Since 1961, Accion has helped build 299 financial service providers serving low\-income clients in 77 countries, reaching over 500 million people. More at https://www.accion.org
 



  





**About Accion Advisory** 




 We are a diverse, close\-knit global team with a common social purpose: building a financially inclusive world for small businesses and low\-income households. The Advisory team is composed of deep technical experts who are passionate about working with a wide range of financial service providers, digital platform providers, FinTech's, and others across Africa, Asia, and Latin America to build sustainable businesses to achieve financial inclusion.
 



 Combining cutting\-edge innovation and a deep understanding of client needs, Accion’s Advisory team offers our partners and the industry unique and strategic insights, as well as operational expertise, grounded in decades of hands\-on support to leading financial service providers (FSPs). Accion Advisory leverages innovations in financial services to lower costs and improve quality at scale, helping build sustainable, scalable institutions focused on serving the financial needs of underserved individuals and micro and small businesses (MSEs). Bringing customer\-centric, data\-driven, tech\-enabled solutions and tools, Accion Advisory delivers support to FSPs and other value\-added service providers to MSEs. We provide strategic and operational support to enhance our partners' capabilities and maximize their impact on underserved populations. We connect local ecosystem actors, harnessing philanthropic capital, digital public infrastructure, and the latest technologies to test, improve, and scale responsible financial solutions that enable small business owners and their families to improve their economic well\-being.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Senior Manager, Advanced Analytics and Data Science, will develop end\-to\-end statistical models required to drive decision\-making and quality improvement in the delivery of financial products, working either directly with Financial Service Providers (FSPs) or consulting organizations that support and work with FSPs or new\-age fintech companies.
 



 The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in machine learning tools, exposure to artificial intelligence (AI) and data analytics, and exposure to financial services. The role requires technical expertise in designing and developing decision tools based on advanced machine learning and AI in the Asian region.
 



 Some key responsibilities include supporting the integration of statistical models with financial product delivery, participating in discussions with executive and project teams to clearly define and ensure delivery against strategic objectives, and overseeing the application and adoption of advanced analytics and risk frameworks, tools, and techniques, both internally and with external project teams.

* Define scope, milestones, KPIs, and deliverables to ensure focused execution for statistical/ML model development.

**Advanced Analytics \& Risk** 



* Develop and control statistical transactional analytic models, integrating applicable Machine learning and relevant AI techniques.
* Manage, develop, and implement statistical models to support credit, collection, account maintenance, recovery processes, customer profiling, and segmentation for product\-related marketing and uptake, etc.

* Ensure that overall project plan objectives are met and advise Regional leads and project managers on performance through timely reporting

* Lead solutions efforts with partners and support project managers in refining and finalizing specific project related deliverables from a model development and analytics perspective.

* Develop high quality documentation and project collaterals to support all BD and implementations.
* Support documentation and collateral development to disseminate learnings and information from various implementations to support knowledge exchange both internally and for external consumption.

 What if your deep knowledge of machine learning, statistical inference, and data engineering could directly influence how the world's most advanced AI models reason and respond?
   

  

 We're looking for experienced data scientists to join Alignerr's expert network and help train cutting\-edge AI systems. You'll stress\-test model reasoning, author gold\-standard solutions, and provide the kind of rigorous technical feedback that makes AI genuinely smarter. description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 Through continued growth comes more demand for business insights and data used to make objective decisions. To support this need and help maintain operational efficiency, A\&M has invested in growing its Business Intelligence Unit (BIU). The BIU creates and maintains scalable data pipelines, constructs analysis, delivers process improvement initiatives and builds visualization tools and applications. The unit is also focused on embedding AI into its own ways of working to drive efficiency, and on enabling the business to apply AI to the data assets the team provides. All with the goal of supporting the firm to realize operational efficiencies identified through analysis. The BIU operates across multiple geographies and practice areas, supporting decision\-making for senior stakeholders across the firm. The Insight Optimisation team is responsible for the ongoing health, evolution, and optimization of the firm's core reporting products. The team manages report consistency, user experience, backend data model improvements, documentation, troubleshooting, and enhancement requests. The team mission is to provide a seamless user experience to the business whilst reducing long\-term operational overhead through prioritising consistency, consolidation, and a focus on action\-driven insights.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 The Business Intelligence Unit is seeking a motivated Associate to join the Insight Optimisation team based in India. Reporting to the Manager of Insight Optimisation, the Associate will play a hands\-on role in maintaining and improving the firm's existing core reporting suite, supporting business users, and contributing to the transition to a new Snowflake data environment.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused role for someone with strong technical foundations in Power BI and SQL, a curiosity for how data is used across a business, and the discipline to work through complex troubleshooting scenarios. The successful candidate will spend their time building improvements to existing reports, investigating data issues, maintaining documentation, and working directly with business users to understand and deliver on their needs. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, comfortable working across the analytics stack, curious about how AI can enhance their work, and eager to develop their skills in a global, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

* Review report usage statistics and user feedback to identify opportunities to improve formatting, usability, and consistency across the reporting suite.
* Implement improvements to existing reports and dashboards, applying user\-centred design principles to enhance the end\-user experience.
* Review dashboard refresh times and backend data models, identifying and applying efficiency improvements in how data is brought into the reporting layer.
* Maintain user guides, definition lists, and technical documentation as new tabs and data sources are added over time.
* Triage and troubleshoot queries received through the BIU inbox, systematically diagnosing whether issues sit at the reporting layer, database level, or source level.
* Escalate complex or cross\-layer issues appropriately and work collaboratively with the wider team to resolve them.
* Support the transition of existing reports to the new Snowflake environment, repointing reports and testing to ensure continuity of service for business users.
* Apply AI and generative AI tools to accelerate day\-to\-day delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Communicate clearly with business users on the status of their requests, expected timelines, and any technical constraints.
* Contribute to team\-wide initiatives to improve ways of working, share knowledge, and raise the collective technical standard of the team
* Keep up to date with the latest tools and techniques in BI, analytics, and AI, and apply them where they can add value


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a data\-focused role.
* Strong report development experience, preferably Power BI, including visualisation, data modelling, and DAX.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write, read, and optimise queries against relational databases.
* Understanding of data modelling concepts and how data flows through a modern analytics stack.
* Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms is desirable; willingness to learn is essential.
* Awareness of current AI and generative AI tools, with an interest in applying them to analytics workflows and reporting products.
* Structured troubleshooting approach, with the ability to isolate problems across the analytics stack.
* Exposure to user\-centred design principles and an appreciation for the end\-user experience of analytics products.
* Familiarity with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
* Experience working in a globally distributed team or across time zones is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a relevant field, or equivalent professional work experience


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

**About Blend**




 Blend is a global technology and data consulting organization helping leading enterprises solve complex business challenges through data, AI, and technology. Our teams work closely with clients to build practical, scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**About the Role**




 We are looking for a
 **Senior Data Scientist** 
 to join a customer analytics engagement. In this role, you will apply machine learning, statistical modeling, and customer analytics to help the client better understand
 **customer value, customer behavior, and movement across value segments** 
 .
   

  





 You will work on problems involving customer lifetime value, customer segmentation, value transitions, causal analysis, and early\-stage next\-best\-action recommendations.
   

  





 This is an evolving engagement, so we are looking for someone who combines
 **strong technical data science skills with business judgment, curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving ambiguous problems** 
 .
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Build and apply
 **machine learning models** 
 to classify customers into low\-, medium\-, and high\-value segments and estimate transitions between these states.
* Develop
 **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)** 
 and customer value models to estimate current and future customer value.
* Analyze customer behavioral and transactional data to identify patterns, drivers, and opportunities to strengthen long\-term customer relationships.
* Apply
 **causal modeling, experimentation, and related analytical techniques** 
 to understand which customer behaviors or interventions influence customer value.
* Contribute to an initial
 **Next Best Action (NBA)** 
 proof of concept to identify strategic opportunities for customer engagement and personalization.
* Develop customer segmentation and behavioral models to identify meaningful customer groups and their characteristics.
* Translate business and marketing questions into practical
 **data science and machine learning approaches** 
 .
* Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, validation, and interpretation.
* Communicate analytical findings and model outputs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to leverage data from a
 **unified customer record** 
 .
* Work in an evolving client environment, proactively identifying opportunities, proposing analytical approaches, and adapting to changing business priorities.
* Connect technical analysis to business outcomes and help stakeholders understand
 **why the model or analysis matters** 
 .


**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**




**Required**



* **3\+ years of hands\-on Data Science / Machine Learning experience** 
 .
* Strong programming skills in
 **Python** 
 .
* Strong
 **SQL** 
 skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Hands\-on experience developing and applying
 **machine learning models** 
 to business problems.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ Predictive modeling
	+ Feature engineering
	+ Model evaluation
	+ Statistical analysis
	+ Customer/behavioral analytics
* Experience with one or more of:
	+ Customer segmentation
	+ Customer Lifetime Value / customer value modeling
	+ Customer behavior modeling
	+ Churn / retention modeling
	+ Propensity modeling
	+ Causal modeling
	+ A/B testing / experimentation
	+ Uplift modeling
	+ Next Best Action / recommendation approaches
* Ability to translate complex analytical problems into practical solutions and communicate insights clearly.
* Strong business judgment and ability to connect analytical outputs to measurable business outcomes.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.



**Preferred Qualifications**



* Experience in
 **customer analytics, marketing analytics, consumer analytics, loyalty, or CRM analytics** 
 .
* Experience working with
 **transactional and behavioral customer data** 
 .
* Experience with customer value segmentation or movement between customer segments.
* Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, experimentation, or treatment\-effect analysis.
* Experience with propensity models, personalization, recommendations, or next\-best\-action frameworks.
* Experience in
 **Retail, CPG, Consumer, E\-commerce, Loyalty, or Marketing Analytics** 
 .
* Experience with PySpark, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or other cloud/data platforms.
* Experience communicating analytical recommendations to senior business stakeholders.


**Additional Information**

**What Success Looks Like**




 In this role, success means being able to move beyond simply building models. You will be expected to:
   

  




* Understand the
 **business problem behind the analytical request** 
 .
* Build models that provide meaningful insight into
 **customer value and behavior** 
 .
* Identify what causes or contributes to changes in customer value.
* Translate analytical findings into
 **clear business recommendations** 
 .
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve the customer analytics approach.
* Work effectively with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and client stakeholders as the engagement evolves.



**Why Blend**




 At Blend, you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful, real\-world data science problems with leading global organizations. You will collaborate with experienced data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders while solving problems where
 **technical depth, business thinking, and the ability to operate in ambiguity** 
 are equally important.
